response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), diffs AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_diff FROM shares) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_diff FROM (SELECT d.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_diff DESC) AS rnk FROM diffs d) t WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY share_diff DESC, observstation

assumptions.assumption: The average share is taken across observatories that have at least one telescope (those appearing in the telescopes table), as the request defines observatories by telescopes.observstation; observatories with zero telescopes are excluded.
Ties at 10th place are handled with RANK() on the computed difference, so all rows tied with the 10th-ranked value are included.
